doc: docs/merge-queue-settings.md. The one source for merge queue settings, approving review count and explicitly scoped required checks. Applied by scripts/apply_merge_queue.py (dry-run by default). Required checks follow the readiness procedure in that document, including the scoped first-check bootstrap for an existing queue with no required contexts.

queue_required_status_checks.note: Merge queues test the combined head; do not require PR branches to be up to date. Applies only to repository rulesets carrying a merge_queue rule. Non-queue strict flags and all exclusions are preserved.

fast_gate.note: ci-ok is the CI gate. The tool reports it fleet-wide and adds or binds checks only for the explicit required_checks targets below; all other required checks are preserved.

review.note: Human approving reviews remain at zero. The exact-head, App-bound review-ok status is the independent review gate on explicitly rolled-out repositories. require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes adds one approving review when a pull request carries commits GitHub cannot attribute to a user (every desk App's), which would hold every bot pull request for an approval ci-ok already made; the tool converges it to false.

exclude.reason: Delivered customer repository: no work unless the customer asks through Kyle.
Platform repository of Cubeage: its merge queue is changed only by its own team.
Archived 2026-10-15: the retired work system. Read-only; its rulesets are left as they are.

overrides.reason: Preserve the existing queue settings read on 2026-11-02 while adopting the Android compilation and package gate; this rollout changes required checks, not queue capacity or grouping.

The passing native/browser merge-group gate completed 82 minutes after enqueue on 2026-11-02, beyond the 60-minute deadline. Allow 120 minutes with margin and preserve the repository's other existing queue settings and required checks.

required_checks.reason: First review gate rollout: preserve CI and bind independent review to its sole App. Apply only after the documented readiness gates and the cloud contract update.
First review gate rollout after producer installation, backfill, live posting and alert readiness.
Review gate rollout after the first two targets read back: preserve CI and bind independent review to its sole App.
Match repository ruleset 20321046: require Actions PR metadata, with ci-ok inherited from the organization. Trusted-main Sylphx PR Review remains advisory and is not a merge-queue gate.

always-loaded is owner's plain-language check on the files every agent loads (.github/workflows/plain-language.yml): owner has reported it on pull request heads since 2026-10-19, so its producer is observed where it is required. ci-ok comes from owner's Rulings workflow. The check is added only after this entry lands; the policy tool never adds it to a repository whose workflows do not produce it.

Build Android now compiles and validates the package on PR, merge_group and main events. Original PR run 41449602348 and merged-main run 41453570358 passed on 2026-11-02. This existing queue had no required checks and no merge-group runs; require the observed producer first, then verify its first real merge group through the necessary delivery-manifest correction. Release remains disabled and is not activated by this policy.

fast_gate_overrides.reason: The deploy/pins branch is gated by its own check, pin-ok, not by the code gate.

_overrides_shape: overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "settings": {"max_entries_to_build": 2}, "reason": "..."}]. fast_gate_overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "context": "pin-ok", "reason": "..."}]. Every entry needs a reason; the settings keys are those under settings.
